name: Produce & Forage Shipped
description: Ship one of every item in the Items Shipped (Farm & Forage) tab in the collections menu.

name: Obelisks on Farm
description: Build Earth Obelisk, Water Obelisk, Desert Obelisk, and Island Obelisk on the farm.

name: Golden Clock on Farm
description: Build Gold Clock on the farm.

name: Monster Slayer Hero
description: Complete all monster eradication goals for the Adventurer's Guild.

name: Great Friends
description: Reach maximum hearts with every villager. This includes Kent, so it is not possible to complete this in year 1. The maximum is 8 hearts for datable villagers and 10 for non-datable villagers. If the player has children, their friendship status does not affect the score.

name: Crafting Recipes Made
description: Craft all items. The Wedding Ring is not required, even in Multiplayer games.

name: Fish Caught
description: Catch every fish in the Fish tab in the collections menu.

name: Golden Walnuts found
description: Find all Golden Walnuts on Ginger Island.
